eyebrow: SQL Server Performance Tuning · Chapter Six
subtitle: Lesson 31 · TempDB & Memory Tuning

code:
EXEC sys.sp_configure 'max server memory', 24576; -- MB
RECONFIGURE;

Too low:  buffer pool can't hold the working set
Too high: starves the OS and other SQL components

Reserve several GB for the OS, give the rest
to max server memory — then watch PLE after.
caption: Measure before, measure after — same discipline as Lesson 1.

code:
SELECT instance_name, cntr_value AS ple_seconds
FROM sys.dm_os_performance_counters
WHERE object_name LIKE '%Buffer Manager%'
  AND counter_name = 'Page life expectancy';
-- instance_name separates the total from each node
caption: Instance-wide can look healthy while one node is under real pressure.

subtitle: Capping one workload so it can't starve another.
